Step: 1566 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 09-29 back 121 days:  
Back 29 days → 08-31 (since September has 30 days).  
Remaining 121 - 29 = 92 days.  
Back 31 days from 08-31 → 07-31.  
Remaining 92 - 31 = 61 days.  
Back 30 days from 07-31 → 07-01.  
Remaining 61 - 30 = 31 days.  
Back 31 days from 07-01 → 05-31.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1566-05-31
